rubric.item: SPEC-13 correctness (E1-E4, U1 exactly as listed, nothing loosened)

findings.issue: SPEC-04's last bullet ('no field other than seat 1's own holeCards') is checked field by field (holeCards, board, earlierShowdowns) rather than over the whole view.
findings.evidence: PlayerView (src/engine/player-view.ts:36-57) has no other field that can carry hole cards, so the check is complete today; a future field would not be covered.
findings.fix: Optionally assert `JSON.stringify(playerView(W2, seat))` contains neither '5h' nor '5s' for seats 2..6.

findings.issue: The `mucked` set never changes the outcome: a seat mucked in pot k is beaten by a shown seat that is eligible for every lower pot (nested eligibility), so re-deciding it would muck it again. Mutation (dropping `|| mucked.has(c.seat)`) passes all tests because it is an equivalent mutant.
findings.evidence: Mutant M5 in a scratch copy: 31/31 tests pass; A-5 itself argues the equivalence.
findings.fix: None required; it states A-5 directly and matches the spec's algorithm. Keep as is.

summary: Engine, view and UI match the spec. showdownOrder rotates to the last river bet/raise record counted or not (A-1), else left of button incl. runouts (D-3); revealShown settles last side pot to main, skips lone-seat pots (A-3), keeps mucks dead (A-5), returns shown in O order (A-4); awards use shown hands with the lone-seat branch. Independent verification: (1) 200,000-hand differential fuzz of the base-commit engine vs the new engine on identical action sequences (2-10 seats, half with $5-$80 stacks; 178k showdowns, 70k multi-pot, 139k with mucks): legalActions, awards, returned, pots and final stacks identical in every hand, and every new showdown entry is byte-equal to the old entry for that seat (pure subset). (2) Playtest --hands 10000 --seed 42 --size 6 byte-identical to base. (3) Mutants killed: main-first settle, bet-only aggressor, any-street aggressor, uncounted-short-raise excluded, showing lone-seat pots, strict > instead of >=. (4) e2e/showdown-shown.spec.ts passes in Chromium and WebKit. Locked edits: E1 [2,5]->[2], E3 sorted [1,3,4] -> exact [3], E4 [1,2,3,5]->[1,2,3] plus the line-16 comment, U1 adds shown: [] - all exactly as listed; E2 replaces set-equality with exact ordered equality against a list the test computes itself (own clockwise split by button, own findLast on river bet/raise, own evaluate running max), failure string unchanged, no engine helper used, and it kills the order mutants - stricter, not looser. No other locked test file changed. e2e/support/table-harness-bundle.ts one-line TableScene union addition is required for openTableScene typing and is in scope. Only NITs.
